justification: Inspected `core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/datamatrix/decoder/DataBlock.java` and its caller `core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/datamatrix/decoder/Decoder.java` (with `Version.java` for context). `DataBlock` is package-private and compact: 118 lines, 2 fields, 1 private constructor, 1 static factory/deinterleaving method, and 2 simple getters.
